scripts.lint: uv run --locked ruff check . && pnpm --filter @soulmate/desktop lint && pnpm --filter @soulmate/desktop rust:lint
scripts.format: uv run --locked ruff format . && pnpm --filter @soulmate/desktop format && pnpm --filter @soulmate/desktop rust:format
scripts.format:check: uv run --locked ruff format --check . && pnpm --filter @soulmate/desktop format:check && pnpm --filter @soulmate/desktop rust:format:check
scripts.test: uv run --locked pytest && pnpm --filter @soulmate/desktop test && pnpm --filter @soulmate/desktop rust:test
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.check:all: pnpm lockfile:check && pnpm check && pnpm hooks:check && pnpm build:python && pnpm build:desktop
